title: Remote Real Estate Lawyer - Brazil
description:
About Moritz

Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.

We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.

We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.

Moritz has raised a $9M seed round from Y Combinator, 20VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.

The Role

  • Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's real estate work in Brazil: commercial leases, sale and purchase agreements, real estate aspects of corporate transactions, and development and construction agreements.
  • Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of leases and property transaction documents for clients ranging from startups taking their first office to enterprises managing property portfolios.
  • Run title review and property due diligence, including for real estate elements of M&A and financing transactions.
  • Advise on real estate financing and security, planning and zoning questions, and landlord-tenant matters.
  • If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years practising commercial real estate law in private practice or in-house.
  • Leasing depth. Office, retail, industrial, and flexible-space leases — rent review, service charges, repair obligations, break options, and assignments.
  • Transactional experience. Sale and purchase agreements, title review and due diligence, conditions, and completion mechanics.
  • Financing familiarity. Mortgages, security packages, and the real estate workstreams of corporate deals.
  • Practical judgment. You separate the points that protect the client from the points that stall the deal.
  • Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.

Why Moritz

  • Bring speed and clarity to real estate transactions traditionally slowed by process.
  • Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice.
  • Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity.
  • Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.

Frequently Asked Questions

How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?

Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.

What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?

Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.

Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?

No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.

How are co-counsel matched to client matters?

Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

title: Business Development Manager
description:
WTS Energy is recruiting a Business Development Manager – Energy & Infrastructure to support the development and expansion of business opportunities across the Brazilian energy market.

This role will focus on business development, tender management, client engagement, and commercial coordination , supporting opportunities across power generation, EPC, renewable energy, water treatment, and desalination sectors in Brazil.

Requirements

  • Monitor and follow tenders and business opportunities within the Brazilian power, energy, and infrastructure markets.
  • Maintain communication with clients and key stakeholders to gather project information and clarify technical and commercial requirements.
  • Coordinate with technical and commercial teams during tender and proposal preparation.
  • Support the collection and analysis of local market information, including material, machinery, manpower, and subcontractor costs.
  • Identify potential local suppliers, subcontractors, and resources to support commercial and tendering activities.
  • Support technical and commercial clarification processes throughout the tendering phase.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with relevant stakeholders across the Brazilian energy and infrastructure market.
  • Support business development initiatives across EPC, power generation, renewable energy, water treatment, and desalination sectors.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Business, Energy, or a related discipline (Master's degree preferred).
  • Minimum 10 years of professional experience within the Energy, Power, Infrastructure, or EPC sectors.
  • Strong experience in business development, commercial activities, tendering, or project development .
  • Previous experience with EPC construction companies, particularly within power generation, is highly valued.
  • Experience in renewable energy, water treatment, or desalination will be considered an advantage.
  • Strong knowledge of the Brazilian energy and infrastructure market.
  • Strong commercial, marketing, negotiation, communication, and relationship management skills.
  • Fluent Portuguese and English (written and spoken) are required.
  • Based in Brazil, with availability to travel domestically and internationally as required.

If you have extensive experience in business development within the Brazilian energy market and a strong background in EPC, power generation, renewable energy, or water infrastructure, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Supervisor de Customer Experience
description:
A Consorciei

Somos a fintech que está transformando o mercado de consórcios no Brasil! Combinamos tecnologia, produtos financeiros e inteligência de dados para criar soluções eficientes para clientes, parceiros e investidores.

  • ~R$ 750 milhões sob nossa gestão;
  • 10 fundos de investimento operados por nós para gerar liquidez ao mercado.

Toda essa jornada e solidez começou com o apoio de investidores de peso que acreditaram no nosso potencial desde o início: o Pátria Investimentos e a Tera Capital.

Acreditamos que grandes transformações acontecem quando pessoas protagonistas se unem para construir o novo. Somos uma fintech que está transformando o mercado de consórcios e buscamos talentos com ambição, espírito empreendedor, colaboração e vontade de fazer acontecer .

Você será responsável por garantir a excelência da operação de atendimento, desenvolver o time e, ao mesmo tempo, identificar oportunidades de melhoria em processos, tecnologia e automação. É uma posição com forte interação com diferentes áreas da empresa e bastante espaço para construção e transformação.

Seu dia a dia será:

  • Gestão da Operação: Acompanhar os principais indicadores da área, como CSAT, NPS, SLA, produtividade e qualidade, identificando desvios e oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Tecnologia e IA: Trabalhar em conjunto com Tecnologia e outras áreas na evolução das automações, ferramentas de IA e canais de autoatendimento;
  • Gestão de Time: Liderar, desenvolver e acompanhar a performance do time de CX, garantindo uma operação eficiente e um ambiente de alta performance;
  • Experiência do Cliente: Transformar feedbacks, reclamações e dados da operação em ações concretas para melhorar a jornada e a experiência dos nossos clientes;
  • Qualidade: Estruturar e acompanhar as rotinas de monitoria, feedback e desenvolvimento, garantindo consistência e qualidade nos atendimentos;
  • Processos e Melhoria Contínua: Mapear gargalos e implementar melhorias nos processos de CX, buscando ganho de eficiência, escala e qualidade;
  • Gestão por Dados: Construir análises e relatórios gerenciais que apoiem a tomada de decisão e direcionem as prioridades da área;
  • Integração entre Áreas: Atuar de forma próxima a Comercial, Tecnologia, Produto e demais áreas, garantindo que os aprendizados de CX sejam incorporados ao negócio;
  • Visão de Negócio: Participar da definição de metas e orçamento da área e atuar em iniciativas estratégicas relacionadas à experiência e ao relacionamento com clientes.

Para brilhar nessa vaga, pode te ajudar:

  • Experiência sólida em gestão de operações de atendimento, Customer Experience, Customer Success ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Experiência prévia em posições de supervisão ou coordenação de times;
  • Perfil analítico e experiência com gestão de indicadores e construção de relatórios;
  • Capacidade de estruturar processos, identificar problemas e implementar soluções;
  • Excelente comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar de forma próxima a diferentes áreas;
  • Forte orientação a resultados e desenvolvimento de pessoas;
  • Interesse e familiaridade com tecnologia, automação e inteligência artificial aplicadas à operação.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com estruturação de áreas de Qualidade em operações de atendimento;
  • Conhecimento de metodologias de qualidade, como COPC;
  • Vivência com ferramentas de IA e automação aplicadas a CX;
  • Experiência com ferramentas como Twilio, SendGrid, Gemini ou similares;
  • Vivência em startups, fintechs ou ambientes de crescimento acelerado.

O que oferecemos:

  • VR/VA flexível via iFood + Clube iFood gratuito;
  • Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;
  • Convênio médico Bradesco;
  • Convênio odontológico Bradesco;
  • Clube de vantagens e descontos nos melhores estabelecimentos;
  • Parceria com SESC e SENAC;
  • Bônus semestral de acordo com o desempenho;
  • TotalPass — acesso a academias em todo o Brasil;
  • Modelo híbrido, 3x por semana no escritório, próximo às estações Fradique Coutinho e Faria Lima.

Se você gosta de liderar pessoas, transformar operações com IA, usar dados e tecnologia para resolver problemas e construir uma experiência cada vez melhor para o cliente, essa vaga é para você!

title: Operador(a) de Frota e Pátio - Veículos Pesados
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Operador(a) de Frota e Pátio Jr. para atuar na movimentação, preparação e controle operacional de veículos, garantindo que estejam em condições adequadas para testes, entregas e devoluções.

Esse(a) profissional terá papel fundamental na organização do pátio, realização de inspeções veiculares, conferência de itens de segurança e suporte às operações de frota, contribuindo para a eficiência e segurança das atividades..

RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Realizar movimentação de veículos no pátio de forma segura e conforme procedimentos internos.
  • Executar abastecimento e preparação dos veículos para testes e operações.
  • Realizar inspeções visuais e checklists operacionais.
  • Conferir documentação e itens obrigatórios de segurança.
  • Verificar condições de pneus, avarias e demais componentes operacionais.
  • Apoiar a instalação e retirada de placas de identificação.
  • Executar atividades de montagem e desmontagem de 5ª roda.
  • Realizar engate e desengate de carretas.
  • Organizar vagas e fluxo de veículos nos estacionamentos e áreas operacionais.
  • Apoiar os processos de entrega e devolução de veículos de teste.
  • Garantir o cumprimento de normas de segurança e qualidade.

REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS

  • CNH Categoria E ativa.
  • Experiência com gestão, controle ou operação de frota.
  • Experiência com movimentação de veículos pesados.
  • Conhecimento em inspeções e checklists veiculares.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação presencial.

DIFERENCIAIS

  • Conhecimento em mecânica automotiva ou mecânica de veículos pesados.
  • Experiência com caminhões e carretas.
  • Vivência em montadoras, centros de testes, transportadoras ou operações logísticas.
  • Experiência com engate de carretas e sistema de 5ª roda.

CONTRATAÇÃO E BENEFÍCIOS

  • Alimentação no local;
  • Plano de saúde Unimed;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • WELLHUB; (antigo Gympass)
  • Horário: Segunda a sexta-feira, das 08h00 às 17h15;
  • Modelo de trabalho: 100% presencial;
  • Local: Curitiba/PR.

title: Analista de Gestão da Qualidade
description:
Você já pensou em fazer parte de umas das principais empresas brasileiras especializada em soluções para ingredientes Industriais?

Então essa posição é para você.

Nós da Indemil temos como propósito nutrir o crescimento do mundo, compartilhando o que temos de melhor todos os dias. Respondemos com agilidade aos desafios dos nossos clientes e entregamos soluções inovadoras com consciência e segurança, superando os principais desafios do mercado e dominando novos processos e tecnologias.

Venha fazer parte!

Principais Responsabilidades do Analista de Gestão da Qualidade:

  • Apoiar no desenvolvimento, implementação e manutenção dos Sistemas de Gestão da Qualidade (SGQ) e de Segurança de Alimentos (SGSA) atuando para a aderência de todas as áreas da organização a seus requisitos e em seus processos de certificação;
  • Realizar, elaborar e manter documentação relativa à área da qualidade e segurança dos alimentos;
  • Investigar e buscar melhorias para os indicadores da qualidade e segurança dos alimentos;
  • Realizar exercícios de rastreabilidade, recolhimento e identificar pontos de melhorias;
  • Realizar a gestão dos documentos de exportação-certificados de livre comércio, certificados de saúde, autorização de venda, entre outros;
  • Acompanhar o processo de renovação de registros e vencimentos das documentações legais;
  • Realizar treinamentos a funcionários referentes ao sistema de gestão da segurança dos alimentos, orientando-os quanto às normas e procedimentos vigentes;
  • Acompanhar análises externas dos produtos acabados;
  • Dar apoio frente a insatisfações de clientes internos e externos (não conformidades), monitorando as investigações de causas e criando condições para evitar reincidência de desvios;
  • Realizar a gestão de homologação e seleção de fornecedores, realizar auditorias em fornecedores e gerenciar os indicadores de desempenho;
  • Realizar a gestão da empresa terceira de controle de pragas;
  • Realizar a integração de colaboradores e terceiros;
  • Executar outras funções não mencionadas, mas pertinentes, seguindo orientação do superior hierárquico;
  • Participar das atividades relacionadas ao sistema de Gestão de Qualidade e Segurança de Alimentos, de acordo com a especificidade da função;
  • Repassar ao superior hierárquico problemas ou anormalidades que ocorrerem decorrentes do processo produtivo.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior completo ou estar cursando Engenharia de Alimentos, Engenharia Química, Biologia ou áreas a fins;
  • Disponibilidade para residir no Município de Paranavaí/PR;
  • Conhecimento do pacote Office.

title: Profissional de Educação Física
description:
Profissional de Educação Física | Recife/PE

CLT | 20h semanais - Horário comercial

A Energié Saúde está com uma oportunidade para Profissional de Educação Física atuar em um programa de saúde corporativa in company, dentro de uma empresa de grande porte em Recife.

Buscamos uma pessoa com boa capacidade técnica, postura acolhedora, organização e interesse em atuar de forma interdisciplinar, conectando atividade física, prevenção, qualidade de vida, saúde integral e mudança de comportamento.

Na Energié, o trabalho do profissional de Educação Física vai além da condução de aulas. A atuação envolve atendimento individual, ações coletivas, educação em saúde, registro de indicadores e colaboração com uma equipe multidisciplinar.

Principais responsabilidades:

• Realizar atendimentos e consultorias individuais em Educação Física para colaboradores da empresa contratante

• Conduzir atendimentos presenciais in loco e, quando necessário, por videochamada com horário agendado

• Ministrar aulas e práticas de modalidades variadas, como exercícios de força, mobilidade, alongamento, caminhada orientada, corrida, grupos de movimento e outras atividades voltadas à promoção da saúde

• Acompanhar a evolução dos participantes, com foco em adesão, segurança, autonomia e melhora gradual dos hábitos de vida

• Ministrar palestras, grupos educativos, workshops e ações coletivas relacionadas à atividade física, saúde, prevenção, ergonomia, bem-estar e estilo de vida

• Registrar informações qualitativas e quantitativas dos atendimentos e ações realizadas

• Contribuir para a construção e análise de indicadores do programa

• Criar conteúdos digitais de apoio, como artigos, postagens, materiais educativos e vídeos

• Atuar de forma integrada com a equipe multidisciplinar da Energié

• Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos, experiências e resultados do programa

Requisitos:

• Graduação em Educação Física, preferencialmente Bacharelado

• CREF ativo

• Experiência com atendimento, orientação ou prescrição de exercícios físicos

• Boa comunicação, escuta ativa e postura acolhedora

• Organização, responsabilidade e atenção aos detalhes

• Facilidade com tecnologia, sistemas e planilhas, especialmente Excel

• Capacidade de registrar informações com precisão e acompanhar dados de forma consistente

• Perfil colaborativo, com facilidade para trabalhar em equipe e atuar de forma interdisciplinar

• Proatividade, comprometimento e foco em solução

• Humildade para aprender, receber feedbacks e evoluir continuamente

• Adaptabilidade para atuar em diferentes formatos de atendimento, ações e demandas corporativas

Será um diferencial:

• Experiência com saúde corporativa, qualidade de vida, atendimento in company ou programas de bem-estar

• Experiência com exercícios de força, caminhada, corrida, mobilidade, ginástica laboral ou práticas coletivas

• Vivência com palestras, workshops, grupos educativos ou ações de promoção da saúde

• Interesse por dados, indicadores e tecnologia aplicada à saúde

• Experiência com mudança de comportamento, adesão ao exercício físico e educação em saúde

Carga horária e local de atuação:

• 20 horas semanais

• Atuação de segunda a sexta-feira, em horário comercial a combinar

• Local: Recife/PE

Benefícios:

• Assistência médica / medicina em grupo

• Seguro de vida em grupo

• Tíquete refeição

• Tíquete alimentação

• Vale transporte

• Wellhub

• Programa de Qualidade de Vida Energié, com iniciativas voltadas à saúde, bem-estar e desenvolvimento de hábitos saudáveis

Perfil que combina com a Energié:

Valorizamos profissionais que unem técnica, cuidado humano e execução. Pessoas que não se limitam a apontar problemas, mas que ajudam a construir soluções com responsabilidade, humildade e senso de colaboração. 

Procuramos alguém que tenha maturidade para atuar em ambiente corporativo, saiba se comunicar com diferentes públicos e consiga equilibrar acolhimento, organização, qualidade técnica e foco em resultado.

Se você quer atuar em uma empresa que está construindo uma forma mais humana, inteligente e mensurável de cuidar da saúde dentro das organizações, essa oportunidade pode fazer sentido para você.

title: Consultor(a) Sênior de Desenvolvimento de Negócios IoT (China)
description:
Conheça mais sobre a empresa

Faça parte de uma empresa que conecta pessoas, negócios e tecnologias, criando soluções inovadoras para um mundo cada vez mais conectado.

Conheça mais sobre a nossa atuação:

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Sua missão nessa conexão!

Desenvolver e expandir relacionamentos estratégicos com clientes, parceiros e fornecedores no Brasil e na China, identificando oportunidades de crescimento de receita, novas soluções e ampliação do portfólio de IoT e devices.

Sua atuação será principalmente consultiva e voltada ao desenvolvimento das contas, transformando necessidades técnicas e comerciais em novas oportunidades de negócio, maior consumo de conectividade e relacionamentos de longo prazo.

No dia a dia, você vai:

  • Desenvolver e fortalecer o relacionamento com clientes, parceiros, fabricantes e fornecedores estratégicos;
  • Identificar oportunidades de expansão de receita dentro da carteira e das parcerias existentes;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva, compreendendo as necessidades dos clientes e propondo soluções em IoT, conectividade, SIM cards e devices;
  • Construir planos de crescimento para contas estratégicas, acompanhando utilização, consumo, resultados e novas possibilidades de negócio;
  • Manter contato contínuo com clientes e parceiros, garantindo proximidade e evolução das oportunidades;
  • Mapear fabricantes e fornecedores chineses com potencial para ampliar o portfólio da empresa;
  • Desenvolver relacionamentos com empresas chinesas dos segmentos de telecomunicações, tecnologia, IoT e dispositivos conectados;
  • Realizar visitas a clientes, fornecedores, fábricas, eventos e feiras do setor;
  • Identificar novos devices e equipamentos com potencial técnico e comercial;
  • Apoiar avaliações, testes e processos de homologação de novos produtos;
  • Desenvolver propostas técnicas e comerciais alinhadas às necessidades dos clientes;
  • Conduzir negociações, renovações, expansões contratuais e ações de aumento de receita;
  • Acompanhar metas, indicadores, pipeline e evolução das oportunidades;
  • Atuar de forma integrada com as áreas de Comercial, Produto, Engenharia, Operações, Jurídico e Suprimentos;
  • Acompanhar tendências e movimentações do mercado chinês de telecomunicações e devices;
  • Prospectar novas oportunidades de forma pontual e estratégica, quando houver aderência ao negócio.

O que você precisa ter:

  • Especialização/MBA em Administração, Gestão Comercial, Engenharia, Tecnologia, Telecomunicações ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de negócios, gestão de contas ou venda consultiva;
  • Vivência nos segmentos de tecnologia, telecomunicações, IoT, conectividade móvel ou devices;
  • Conhecimento em soluções de IoT, M2M, MVNO, SIM cards, consumo de dados ou dispositivos conectados;
  • Experiência com prospecção, negociação e relacionamento com clientes, parceiros ou fornecedores;
  • Capacidade de transitar entre discussões técnicas, comerciais e estratégicas;
  • Perfil consultivo, estratégico, autônomo e orientado para resultados;
  • Inglês avançado para reuniões, negociações e interações profissionais;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens nacionais e internacionais;
  • Disponibilidade para períodos de atuação na China.

Será um diferencial:

  • Experiência com fornecedores ou fabricantes chineses;
  • Vivência no mercado asiático;
  • Conhecimento do ecossistema de telecomunicações e tecnologia na China;
  • Idioma Mandarim;

Local de atuação

Faria Lima/SP e China

O que você encontra na nossa rede:

Além de um time colaborativo, conectado ao futuro e aberto à inovação, nós também oferecemos:

  • VR (Vale Refeição também para os dias de Home Office), VA e Gratificação de Férias no VR/VA;
  • Comissão e bônus trimestrais
  • Assistência Médica, Odontológica e seguro de vida;
  • PPR (Programa de Participação por Resultados);
  • Flexibilidade: Modelo de trabalho híbrido com 2 dias em HOME OFFICE;
  • Bem-Estar: Wellhub (TotalPass), frutas no escritório e o programa Elleva; (acompanhamento de equipe multidisciplinar de nutricionista, educador físico e psicólogo), convênio farmácia e auxílio medicamentos para patologias graves;
  • Licença maternidade 6 meses + Licença paternidade 20 dias (VR e VA durante todo o período);
  • Auxílio creche até 6 anos;

  • Vale-transporte, reembolso de estacionamento ou fretado;
  • Reconhecimento: Prêmios por tempo de trabalho na empresa e reconhecimento por desempenho no trabalho;

  • Leggal – Plataforma de orientação jurídica com direito a até duas consultas mensais;

Vivência em empresas de tecnologia, telecomunicações ou SaaS.

Negociação e Fechamento

Resiliência e adaptabilidade.

Perfil "mão na massa".

title: HR Specialist
description:
Join Aerial Core - the back office that keeps pace with your ambition

Aerial Core is a modern, tech-enabled back-office partner that supports growing businesses through accounting, finance, and people operations services. We’ve intentionally broken the mold of traditional accounting firms by placing relationships, collaboration, and innovation at the center of how we work.

At Aerial Core, we believe HR is strategic, insightful, and human-driven. Our people-first culture values trust, independence, and efficiency, empowering every team member to do their best work while helping clients thrive.

We’re now looking for a tech-savvy, organized, and people-focused HR Specialist to join our remote team. Please be informed that this is a contractor position and we will require your CNPJ. This is the perfect opportunity for an experienced HR professional who values autonomy, flexibility, and performance-based rewards. You’ll work directly with clients, support their day-to-day people operations, and leverage technology to deliver efficient, practical, and high-quality HR support.

Please note: To be considered for this position, applicants must submit their resume in English. Applications with resumes submitted in other languages will not be considered.

What You’ll Do
  • Provide day-to-day HR support for assigned clients, acting as an extension of their internal team and primary point of contact for HR-related matters.
  • Manage employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, employee changes, leave, offboarding, and maintaining accurate employee records.
  • Support clients with HR administration, policies, procedures, employee communications, and general HR questions.
  • Coordinate new hire onboarding, including HRIS setup, employment documentation, I-9 and W-4 processes, benefits enrollment, and onboarding materials.
  • Support recruiting activities, including job descriptions, candidate communications, interview coordination, offers, and pre-employment processes.
  • Assist managers and employees with employee relations matters, workplace concerns, performance issues, and policy questions.
  • Support and document employee relations matters and workplace investigations, escalating complex or sensitive issues when appropriate.
  • Assist with benefits administration, open enrollment, employee communications, and coordination with benefits providers and brokers.
  • Maintain and update employee handbooks, HR policies, forms, templates, and other HR documentation.
  • Research and support compliance with applicable federal, state, and local employment requirements.
  • Coordinate with external payroll, benefits, accounting, legal, and other professional service providers as needed.
  • Manage and maintain HRIS systems and workflow platforms.
  • Communicate with clients and team members through various communication channels like Slack, Zoom, and Google Workspace.
  • Use Asana and Everhour to track projects, deliverables, client requests, and timelines.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve HR processes, automate administrative tasks, and increase efficiency.
  • Develop clear employee-facing communications, manager resources, training materials, and HR guides.
  • Ensure HR work is accurate, timely, confidential, and aligned with Aerial Core’s quality expectations.
What We’re Looking For
  • Fluent in English
  • Strong knowledge of day-to-day HR processes and the employee lifecycle.
  • Experience supporting employee relations and handling confidential employee matters with discretion.
  • Strong understanding of HR administration, onboarding, benefits, compliance, and HR policies.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and ability to manage multiple clients and priorities independently.
  • Flexibility around working hours, with the understanding that some tasks may require availability during US business hours (mainly Pacific Time).
  • Comfortable working directly with clients and providing professional, practical HR guidance.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote-first environment using digital tools.
Nice to Have
  • Some familiarity with US employment practices and HR compliance, including federal and state employment requirements.
  • Experience with common HRIS platforms like BambooHR and Workday.
  • Experience with Asana and Everhour or any other workflow automation tools.
  • Familiarity with CRMs or project management systems such as Asana
  • Prior experience working with startups or small businesses.
Why You’ll Love Working With Us

At Aerial Core, we do things differently:

  • Trust and Independence: You are your own boss. We trust your expertise and give you the freedom to manage your time and workload.
  • Efficiency and Innovation: We embrace technology and encourage experimentation. If you find a better way to work, we’ll support it.
  • Collaboration and Growth: We win as a team. Our culture is built on helping each other, learning together, and celebrating shared success.
  • Performance-Driven Rewards: Your efforts directly impact your earnings. You’ll receive a retainer contract of R$3,300 with the option to qualify for more contracts. 
  • Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere, anytime as long as deadlines are met and excellence is maintained.
The Aerial Core Way
  • Relationships over Transactions: We build lasting relationships by deeply understanding our clients and delivering real value.
  • Strategic Thinking & Judgment: We go beyond the surface, identifying root causes and providing actionable insights.
  • Open Communication: We value transparency and see mistakes as opportunities for growth.
  • Excellence & Accountability: We aim for 10/10 work — delivered early, reviewed thoroughly, and executed with care.

Ready to work differently?

Join a modern, digital-first team where your independence, innovation, and impact truly matter.

title: Analista de Recrutamento e Seleção Sênior
description:
Sobre a vaga

Buscamos um(a) Analista de Recrutamento e Seleção para integrar nossa equipe de Recursos Humanos. O(a) profissional será responsável por conduzir processos seletivos de ponta a ponta, garantindo a atração e seleção dos melhores talentos para as diversas áreas da empresa.

  • Excelente comunicação interpessoal e escrita.

title: Portugues and Spanish Bilingual LQA Freelancer
description:
Company Description

Gravity Interactive, Inc., established in California in 2003, is a leading online gaming service provider, catering to gamers across North America and worldwide. As a wholly owned subsidiary of Gravity Co., Ltd., headquartered in Seoul, Republic of Korea, Gravity Interactive is globally recognized for delivering top-tier gaming experiences. Gravity Co., Ltd. is best known for developing the acclaimed MMORPG title, Ragnarok Online, which continues to engage a diverse international audience. With a commitment to innovation and global reach, Gravity Interactive remains at the forefront of the online gaming industry.

Role Description

This is a month-to-month contract role for a Portuguese and Spanish Bilingual LQA Specialist, for the project we estimate to last approximately 6 months. The role involves conducting linguistic quality assurance (LQA) tests for gaming content, identifying and rectifying translation errors, and ensuring linguistic accuracy and cultural relevance in Portuguese and Spanish, ensuring consistency in the use of terminology across game mechanics, in-game items, storyline elements, and related materials. This position will assess text placement within the user interface and make linguistic adjustments where necessary to accommodate language expansion or contraction. The specialist will collaborate with the QA team and other departments when relevant, offering linguistic or localization support to facilitate overall project quality.

Qualifications

  • Be able to translate minimum of 2000 words/day and/or to review/edit 5000 words/day
  • Fluency in Portuguese and Spanish, with strong command of written and verbal communication in both languages
  • Experience in Linguistic Quality Assurance (LQA) testing or localization, with the ability to identify and address linguistic, cultural, and contextual inaccuracies
  • Knowledge of the gaming industry, familiarity with MMORPGs, and a passion for video games
  • Strong detail-oriented mindset, problem-solving abilities, and capacity to meet deadlines in a hybrid work environment
  • Proficiency in translation and localization tools; basic technical aptitude is a plus
  • Bachelor's degree in Linguistics, Translation, Localization, or a related field preferred
  • Prior experience working in a multicultural environment is advantageous

title: Crane Operator
description:
Position: Crane Operator

Location: FPSO Marechal Duque de Caxias

About Us

MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.

For over 57 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.

Job Purpose

The Crane Operator is responsible for the safe and efficient operation of pedestal cranes and other lifting equipment onboard, supporting ship-to-ship and inboard lifting operations in accordance with established procedures, operating limits, and company safety standards.

Key Responsibilities

Operate pedestal cranes in accordance with established procedures, operating limits, and safety requirements;

Drive pedestal cranes during ship-to-ship and inboard lifting operations;

Operate electro-mechanical lifting equipment, excluding pedestal cranes;

Inspect lifting gear regularly and prior to the commencement of lifting operations;

Perform predictive and routine maintenance activities related to pedestal cranes in accordance with procedures and CMMS work orders;

Communicate effectively with riggers, signal persons, and site supervisors to coordinate lifting operations safely and efficiently;

Monitor lifting operations and ensure compliance with applicable procedures and safety requirements;

Respond appropriately to emergency situations and participate in emergency response activities as required;

Perform routine maintenance activities and promptly report mechanical, operational, or safety-related issues;

Maintain accurate records of crane operations, maintenance activities, inspections, and relevant equipment conditions;

Ensure compliance with onboard safety procedures, company policies, and applicable regulatory requirements;

Maintain a strong safety-focused approach throughout all lifting and crane operations.

Requirements

Valid Crane Operator certification/licence applicable to offshore lifting operations;

Previous experience operating pedestal cranes in offshore, FPSO, maritime, or oil & gas environments;

Demonstrated experience with ship-to-ship and inboard lifting operations;

Knowledge of lifting equipment, lifting gear, and safe lifting practices;

Familiarity with crane inspection, maintenance, and CMMS work orders;

Ability to communicate effectively with riggers, signal persons, and supervisors during lifting operations;

Knowledge of offshore safety procedures and emergency response requirements;

Basic to intermediate English communication skills;

Strong teamwork, communication, discipline, and safety-oriented mindset;

Ability to work effectively in an offshore environment and follow established procedures and operating limits.

Benefits

Meal and food allowances

Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, with no co-pay)

Life Insurance

Annual Bonus

Private Pension Plan

Childcare Allowance

Note

This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.

MISC is committed to diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from professionals of all backgrounds.

title: Senior Graphic Designer
description:
Senior Graphic Designer (AI Capability)

Remote, Full-Time (40 hrs/week) | US Business Hours | Long-Term Contract

About the Role

Our client is a fast-growing US-based venture studio operating across health, beauty, food, and beverage CPG brands. They're looking for a Senior Graphic Designer with strong AI fluency to support branding, packaging, and paid marketing creative across a portfolio of multi-brand projects. This role blends hands-on execution with creative direction — you'll be trusted to own your output end to end, in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design branding and packaging assets for CPG products across multiple brands
  • Create paid social ad creative (Meta, Google, TikTok) aligned to performance goals
  • Design email marketing assets that support campaign and lifecycle strategy
  • Integrate AI tools into the design workflow to speed up production without sacrificing quality
  • Manage several projects simultaneously and consistently deliver on tight turnarounds
  • Provide creative direction on your own work — no separate art director layer
  • Maintain visual consistency and brand standards across a multi-brand portfolio
  • Proactively flag issues or bottlenecks and act on them rather than waiting for direction

Requirements

  • 4+ years of professional graphic design experience
  • Experience working in an agency or other high-output creative environment
  • Hands-on experience designing packaging for consumer brands (CPG)
  • Demonstrated experience designing paid media ad creative (Meta, Google, and/or TikTok)
  • Regular use of AI tools in a professional design workflow (e.g., Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, or similar)
  • Fluent, professional-level English (written and verbal)
  • Full-time availability aligned with US business hours

Nice to have:

  • Experience designing email marketing assets
  • Experience providing creative direction while also executing hands-on design work
  • Background working with multiple brands or clients simultaneously

Ideal Candidate

This person is a strong, self-directed designer who doesn't need heavy oversight to stay on pace. They move quickly without cutting corners, ask questions when something's unclear instead of guessing, and take ownership when something isn't working rather than waiting to be told. They're comfortable juggling multiple projects across different brands at once, and they see AI tools as a natural part of how they work — not an afterthought. They bring both strong visual craft and the organizational discipline to consistently hit fast turnarounds.

title: ICSS Technician
description:
Position: ICSS Technician

Location: FPSO Marechal Duque de Caxias

About Us

MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.

For over 56 years, we have been a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and sustainable value to our stakeholders around the world.

Job Purpose

Execute ICSS performance to meet its technical specifications, ensuring system operability, safety, traceability, and compliance with operational and cybersecurity requirements.

Responsibilities

Operate, monitor, and troubleshoot DeltaV ICSS (DCS / SIS);

Monitor alarms, system health, and performance trends;

Support start-ups, normal operations, shutdowns, and emergency situations;

Apply and manage system inhibitions and overrides in accordance with procedures and PTW;

Perform first-line diagnostics on controllers, I/O, HMIs, servers, and industrial networks;

Liaise with shore-based teams and DeltaV / Siemens OEM support, as required;

Support emergency response activities when required.

Requirements

Technical Degree in Instrumentation, Automation, or Electrical Engineering;

Minimum 5 years of experience with automation/control systems, preferably in offshore or oil & gas operations;

Hands-on experience with DeltaV ICSS and DeltaV SIS;

Experience with Siemens packages/systems associated with the ICSS;

Experience with industrial communication networks, including Profibus / Profinet;

Strong troubleshooting and alarm management skills;

English: Advanced (mandatory);

Microsoft Office 365®: Intermediate.

Benefits

Meal and food allowances.

Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, with no co-pay).

Life Insurance.

Annual Bonus.

Private Pension Plan.

Childcare Allowance.

Note:

This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.

MISC values diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from professionals of all backgrounds, including women, Black and Indigenous individuals, PCDs, and LGBTQIA+ people.

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.

title: Finance and Treasury Manager
description:
Who are we?

CFI Financial Group is an award-winning trading provider, possessing more than 25 years of experience with multiple offices around the world including London, Larnaca, Beirut, Amman, Dubai, Port Louis, and others.

CFI is hiring! Make your mark in the online trading industry.

Are you looking to pursue a career in finance? Do you want to work with a dynamic and growing team in the exciting world of online trading and investing? If you answered yes, then we have some amazing opportunities for you!

Job Description:

We are hiring a talented Finance and Treasury Manager professional to join our team.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage the daily cash position of CFI Brazil.
  • Monitor local bank accounts, liquidity and cash movements.
  • Manage treasury processes and payment flows.
  • Perform and/or supervise daily and periodic financial reconciliations.
  • Reconcile CFI Brazil's position with the local partner and relevant service providers.
  • Coordinate financial information with Group Finance.
  • Prepare local financial management reports.
  • Coordinate applicable regulatory financial reporting.
  • Maintain appropriate financial records and controls.
  • Establish the local finance reporting calendar.
  • Monitor expenses, invoices, payments and cash-flow requirements.
  • Support budgeting and forecasting.
  • Prepare management information for local and Group management.
  • Coordinate with external accountants, auditors and other financial service providers.
  • Establish financial procedures and internal controls.
  • Identify financial and operational risks within the treasury process.
  • Support the implementation of accounting/finance systems and integrations.
  • Ensure timely delivery of required reports to Brazilian authorities and relevant market institutions.
  • Build the local Finance & Treasury function as CFI Brazil grows.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of relevant Finance/Treasury experience, preferably within a Brazilian CTVM/DTVM, brokerage, bank or regulated financial institution.
  • Strong understanding of Brazilian financial-market operations.
  • Previous experience with treasury and daily cash management.
  • Experience with financial reconciliation.
  • Experience with regulatory financial reporting in Brazil.
  • Strong Excel/financial analysis skills.
  • Ability to work independently and establish processes from the beginning.
  • Strong English — mandatory, given direct interaction with CFI Group Finance.
  • Experience with financial systems and brokerage/back-office systems is desirable.

Why join CFI?

  • We’re a fast-growing, multinational company
  • Competitive salaries and benefits
  • Work and learn with industry professions
  • Supportive and collaborative environment
  • Unlimited opportunities for growth and development

title: Senior HR Analyst - Systems
description:
About Us

At Lightera, we empower our employees to grow, innovate, and make a meaningful impact on the world. We foster a supportive, dynamic, and inclusive workplace where people can thrive, collaborate, and drive positive change.

If you are looking for a rewarding career with opportunities to learn, lead, and contribute to cutting-edge innovation, this opportunity could be for you!

We are looking for a Senior HR Analyst , with a strong focus on HR Systems and Processes. This role will be responsible for supporting the implementation, maintenance, optimization, integration, and transformation of HR systems, representing the needs and requirements of the LATAM region in global initiatives and ensuring alignment with corporate guidelines and solutions.

  • Knowledge of Brazilian labor legislation and regulatory requirements; knowledge of other LATAM countries is a plus.
  • Proven experience supporting and/or leading HR technology implementation and transformation projects.
  • Experience working in multinational organizations, across regions and with cross-functional teams.
  • Knowledge of process mapping, continuous improvement, and project management.

Responsibilities:

HR Systems & Technology

  • Represent the LATAM region in global HR technology discussions, projects, and forums.
  • Act as the regional point of contact for HR systems and HR operational processes.
  • Support the evaluation, configuration, testing, implementation, and optimization of HR technology platforms.
  • Ensure that business requirements from the LATAM region are properly identified and incorporated into global solutions.
  • Coordinate, together with the IT team, system updates, integrations, enhancements, and regional implementations.
  • Identify opportunities to standardize, automate, and improve HR processes through technology.
  • Monitor trends in HR technology, including AI and automation, and recommend opportunities for improvement.

Legacy Systems Management

  • Support the administration, maintenance, and continuous improvement of existing HR systems.
  • Coordinate issue resolution, process improvements, and user support activities.
  • Support data migration, testing, validation, and system transition activities.
  • Ensure business continuity throughout migrations and transformation initiatives.
  • Maintain up-to-date documentation of systems, processes, and configurations.
  • Ensure compliance with data privacy and security requirements, including Brazil’s LGPD.

Project & Transformation Management

  • Participate in and coordinate regional HR technology and process transformation projects.
  • Develop project plans, timelines, stakeholder communications, and risk mitigation strategies.
  • Coordinate collaboration among HR, IT, Finance, payroll providers, external partners, and business stakeholders.
  • Support change management activities, including training, communication, and user adoption.
  • Track project progress and support successful implementation and adoption.

Payroll & HR Operations

  • Partner with Payroll and HR Operations teams to improve process effectiveness, controls, and compliance.
  • Support payroll-related systems, integrations, reporting, and controls.
  • Support the development and standardization of regional HR procedures and controls.
  • Monitor changes in labor legislation and regulatory requirements across LATAM countries.
  • Assess and support the implementation of required changes to HR systems, processes, and controls.

Location: Cidade Industrial de Curitiba, Brazil

Work Model: Hybrid – 2 days working from home

Apply today and join the Lightera team!

  • Apoiar as áreas operacionais na padronização de processos e na solução de problemas relacionados à qualidade;
  • Gerenciar planos de ação decorrentes de auditorias, inspeções e avaliações de desempenho;
  • Atuar na identificação, avaliação e mitigação de riscos relacionados à qualidade dos processos, produtos e serviços;
  • Promover e realizar capacitações para equipe interna e das unidades referente ao processo de qualidade e segurança do paciente.

title: Head Comercial (OneFlow)
description:
A OneFlow é uma empresa de tecnologia que nasceu para transformar a forma como os escritórios de contabilidade trabalham. Somos uma plataforma contábil 100% web, construída com uma visão moderna de produto, automação e inteligência artificial, com o propósito de simplificar processos complexos e aumentar significativamente a produtividade dos escritórios contábeis.

  • Liderar a estratégia e a operação comercial da OneFlow, contribuindo diretamente para o crescimento da empresa;
  • Gerenciar e expandir formar um time comercial de alta performance, criando uma cultura orientada a resultados, colaboração e evolução contínua;
  • Definir e acompanhar metas, indicadores de desempenho, pipeline, forecast e taxas de conversão da área comercial;
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos comerciais, buscando continuamente maior produtividade, eficiência e previsibilidade de vendas;

  • Conhecer profundamente nossos clientes, suas necessidades e o mercado contábil, levando aprendizados da operação comercial para as demais áreas da empresa;
  • Contribuir ativamente para o planejamento e execução da próxima etapa de crescimento da OneFlow.
  • Participar ativamente dos eventos que a OneFlow estiver presente;

Requisitos e qualificações

Buscamos uma pessoa que tenha:

  • Experiência sólida na comercialização de software B2B , preferencialmente em empresas SaaS;
  • Experiência comprovada em gestão de equipes comerciais , incluindo contratação, formação e desenvolvimento de profissionais;
  • Histórico consistente de atingimento e superação de metas e excelentes resultados comerciais ;
  • Vivência em empresas de tecnologia, startups ou scale-ups em momentos de crescimento e transformação;
  • Experiência na estruturação e evolução de processos e estratégias comerciais;
  • Conhecimento de diferentes estratégias de geração de oportunidades e aquisição de novos clientes;
  • Forte domínio de gestão de funil, pipeline, forecast, conversão e indicadores de performance comercial;
  • Experiência com CRM e gestão comercial orientada a dados;
  • Perfil de liderança próximo da operação, com capacidade de transitar entre estratégia e execução;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em ambientes dinâmicos, com autonomia, velocidade e constante evolução.

Serão grandes diferenciais:

Procuramos, acima de tudo, uma liderança com mentalidade de crescimento, forte orientação a resultados e capacidade de construir . title: Retail Credit Risk Manager
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

Risk at Revolut operates across all functions, products, and regions to monitor front-line performance and ensure the business operates safely. They’re among the first to be involved in new initiatives, from tech to customer support.

We’re looking for a Risk Manager to support our growing retail credit portfolio. You'll make data-driven decisions on risk-adjusted return requirements and lead preventive and reactive actions that impact portfolio credit performance and profitability.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

What you'll be doing

  • Managing exposure to retail credit risk
  • Maintaining risk appetite through limit calibration and monitoring
  • Engaging with key stakeholders, committees, and regional regulators on material retail credit risk exposures and limit governance
  • Optimising key policies, procedures, and controls
  • Engaging with first-line businesses to identify, monitor, and govern emerging retail credit risks, including new product risk assessments
  • Quantifying risk exposures, considering stakeholder impact where possible
  • Protecting the company from excessive risk-taking, saving on both short and long-term costs
  • Building trust and reputation with our external stakeholders
  • Identifying emerging risks that require immediate attention or that could threaten long-term viability

What you'll need

  • 6+ years of experience in consumer credit risk within financial services, banks, payment institutions, and/or related services
  • Knowledge of key products, like credit cards and unsecured personal loans
  • A quantitative background in STEM (science, technology, engineering, and mathematics), statistics, economics, or related fields
  • Fluency in English

Nice to have

  • Experience within the second line of defence (risk)
  • Impressive programming skills using Python, R, and/or SQL

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: SBS Operations Senior Manager
description:
At Sherwin-Williams, we color the world! With more than 150 years of global excellence, we are a leader in the paints and coatings industry, recognized for innovation, quality, and our commitment to sustainability.

We are seeking an experienced SBS Operations Senior Manager to lead and advance our Shared Business Services operations across Brazil. This role partners closely with SBS Service Delivery teams and business leaders to drive service excellence, operational effectiveness, and strategic growth.

The SBS Operations Senior Manager plays a critical role in overseeing regional service delivery, managing demand pipelines, capacity planning, service placement strategies, and supporting key SBS initiatives across Brazil. This leader will also be responsible for monitoring and improving Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), ensuring the organization consistently delivers high-quality, efficient, and scalable services. Beyond operational leadership, this role is empowered to drive transformation through influence, collaboration, communication, and execution. Working closely with cross-functional teams, the successful candidate will champion process standardization, harmonization, optimization, and automation, while fostering a culture of continuous improvement, strong governance, and operational excellence.

We are looking for a strategic and influential leader who thrives in complex environments, builds strong partnerships across Finance, IT, Supply Chain, and business functions, and is passionate about developing high-performing teams while driving meaningful business impact across Brazil and LATAM.

São Bernardo do Campo, SP, Brazil | Hybrid (3x2)

Key Responsibilities

  1. Build and manage regional processes, business requirements, documentation, playbooks, SOPs, and knowledge repositories. Manage and continuously enhance SBS processes within the service catalog, including the evaluation of current services, regional systems, taxonomies, tools, business process master lists, and repository governance.
  2. Lead the execution of the regional transition program , focusing on process standardization, harmonization, streamlining, optimization, and control analysis. Partner closely with SBS Service Delivery teams to identify, design, and implement process improvement initiatives and supporting tools.
  3. Prepare and manage the facility budget , process facility-related charges, and monitor expenditures throughout the year to ensure proper financial oversight and cost control.
  4. Partner with SBS leadership to build the foundation for the organization and support its continued growth and maturity, driving sustainable operational capabilities and organizational effectiveness.
  5. Execute regional transition initiatives to ensure smooth service transfers, effective stakeholder alignment, and seamless handoffs between teams.
  6. Develop and implement programs that strengthen operational excellence capabilities , including the assessment, design, and deployment of training initiatives. Promote consistent ways of working, cross-functional collaboration, waste reduction, process standardization, and risk mitigation.
  7. Serve as a senior influencer across global, regional, and local leadership teams. Lead change management efforts to drive adoption of standardized SBS processes and operating models. Build strong partnerships across Finance, SBS, IT, Supply Chain, and business functions, while effectively communicating vision, progress, and outcomes to executive stakeholders.
  8. Build and develop high-performing teams across LATAM. Drive initiatives that enhance operational excellence capabilities, professional development, and organizational effectiveness. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and learning.

Education

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Accounting, or a related field.

Preferred:

  • MBA, CPA, or other advanced professional certification.

Knowledge & Experience

  • 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in Finance, Shared Services, Operations, or a related business function, with a proven track record in operational excellence, process management, transformation, and business partnership.
  • Fluent in English, with strong verbal and written communication skills. Spanish proficiency is preferred.
  • Strong ability to influence senior stakeholders, build cross-functional relationships, and drive alignment across global, regional, and local teams.
  • Excellent communication, analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and decision-making skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deliver results.
  • Demonstrated success leading teams both directly and through influence in a matrixed environment.
  • Experience within a Shared Services Center (SSC), multinational organization, or business transformation environment is highly desirable.
  • Previous people leadership experience and exposure to transition management, continuous improvement, and change management initiatives are preferred.

Technical Skills

  • Working knowledge of end-to-end business processes, including areas such as Record-to-Report (RTR), Procure-to-Pay (PTP), Order-to-Cash (OTC), Hire-to-Retire (HTR), and other Shared Services processes.
  • Understanding of Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and performance management frameworks.
  • Experience developing execution strategies, operating procedures, governance models, and process documentation.
  • Knowledge of process improvement methodologies, process standardization, and operational excellence principles.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Experience with Shared Services technologies, workflow tools, automation solutions, and ERP platforms.
  • Knowledge of continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, or similar frameworks.
  • Experience supporting automation, digital transformation, or process optimization initiatives.

About Us

At Sherwin-Williams, our purpose is to inspire and improve the world by coloring and protecting what matters. Our paints, coatings, and innovative solutions make the places and spaces in our world brighter and stronger. Your skills, talent, and passion make it possible for you to live this purpose while enabling our customers and our company to achieve exceptional results.

Sherwin-Williams recognizes your dedication, growth, and ambition and translates them into opportunities for our team. Our people are the foundation of our success, and we invest in and support you:

In your life ... with recognition, benefits, and flexibility to improve your health and well-being.

About Wayzim

Wayzim Technology Co., Ltd. () is a leading global provider of intelligent logistics automation solutions. We specialize in advanced sorting systems, conveyor technologies, and smart warehouse infrastructure, serving top e-commerce, express delivery, and 3PL leaders worldwide.

We are looking for a proactive, fast-learning Pre-Sales Engineer based in the São Paulo area to serve as a key technical bridge between our Latin America sales team, regional clients, and HQ mechanical design engineers in China.

  • English: Fluent (written & spoken, required for daily communication with headquarters).

  • Location & Mobility: Based in or near São Paulo, Brazil . Must hold a valid passport and be willing to travel internationally across Latin America for site visits and equipment training.
  • Key Traits: High self-motivation, strong independent learning capability, and excellent cross-cultural communication skills.

What We Offer

  • Flexible remote work model with travel opportunities across Latin America.

  • Vale refeição

Para isso, as decisões e oportunidades de emprego na Dori | Ferrara serão baseadas no mérito, nas qualificações e nas habilidades, independentemente da raça, cor, credo, religião, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade e expressão de gênero, estado civil ou união civil, nacionalidade, ascendência, cidadania, idade, condição de militar ou veterano, deficiência, informações genéticas, gravidez (parto ou condição médica relacionada) ou qualquer outra base proibida por lei.

A Dori | Ferrara não realiza cobranças para a participação de processos seletivos e toda a nossa comunicação é feita através dos canais oficiais da empresa. Se receber qualquer mensagem solicitando pagamento ou dados de cartão de crédito, pedimos que não responda e entre em contato imediatamente com nossos canais oficiais de atendimento (redes sociais ou SAC ).

Em conformidade com a Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD), informamos que todos os dados pessoais fornecidos durante o processo seletivo serão utilizados exclusivamente para fins de recrutamento e seleção. As informações serão tratadas com confidencialidade, segurança e armazenadas apenas pelo período necessário para o processo, sendo posteriormente descartadas de forma segura.

title: Logistics Specialist- First Mile
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!

Key Responsibilities

● Pickup Operations Management: Oversee daily pickup operations across Brazil, ensuring sellers are collected within SLA and operational targets. Coordinate pickup flows with logistics providers, monitor execution quality, and proactively address operational risks, delays, and capacity constraints.

● Supplier Coordination & Performance Management: Manage relationships with pickup service providers and carriers, conducting regular operational reviews, aligning volume forecasts, and ensuring compliance with company standards and KPIs. Drive accountability and corrective actions when performance deviations occur.

● Data Analysis & Decision Making: Analyze operational data, pickup performance, seller behavior, capacity utilization, and cost indicators to support strategic and operational decision-making. Develop reports and dashboards to identify trends, operational bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities.

● Operational Planning & Execution: Support short-, medium-, and long-term pickup planning, balancing operational efficiency, service quality, and cost optimization. Coordinate operational contingencies during peak periods and large-scale campaigns.

● Process Optimization & Continuous Improvement: Identify operational gaps and implement initiatives to improve pickup efficiency, reduce failures, enhance seller experience, and optimize operational costs. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve systems, operational processes, and execution standards.

● Incident Management & Escalation Handling: Lead operational issue resolution related to pickup execution, seller complaints, collection failures, and supplier performance. Ensure fast escalation, root cause analysis, and implementation of preventive actions.

● Field Operations & Seller Experience: Conduct field visits with logistics providers and sellers to validate operational standards, improve pickup experience, and ensure operational compliance. Maintain close visibility of frontline operational challenges.

● Strategic Projects & Network Development: Support strategic initiatives related to pickup network expansion, operational model optimization, collection point management, and logistics performance improvement projects.

Requirements

● Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or related fields.

● Minimum of 5 years of experience in logistics operations in Brazil, preferably in e-commerce, express logistics, or first mile operations.

● Strong knowledge of pickup operations, logistics supplier management, operational KPIs, and field execution.

● Data-Driven Mindset: Strong analytical skills with the ability to make operational decisions based on data, performance indicators, and operational trends.

● Operational & Analytical Profile: Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on operational execution in a fast-paced environment.

● Problem-Solving Skills: Strong ability to identify root causes, manage operational risks, and implement corrective and preventive actions.

● Supplier Management Experience: Experience coordinating logistics providers, conducting performance reviews, and driving operational improvements.

● Project Management Skills: Experience leading operational improvement initiatives and cross-functional logistics projects.

● Hands-on Approach: Willingness to engage directly with field operations, logistics providers, and sellers to ensure operational excellence.

● Portuguese fluency is mandatory.

● Intermediate English is required; fluent English is considered a strong plus.

● Spanish and/or Mandarin are considered a plus.

CAREERS AT SHEIN

We Commit to Inclusion

At SHEIN, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community and all types of diversity.

We Empower Talents with Diverse Careers

At SHEIN, we empower talent to excel with regular opportunities to elevate their career in their respective fields. As a dynamic business, we support internal mobility, diverse career pathways and recognition of success and contribution in a variety of meaningful ways.

We Engage with Global Cultures

SHEIN has over 20 offices worldwide , providing talent with many opportunities to collaborate with colleagues around the world. Perspective sharing and leveraging cultural differences, is one of our core strenghts as we work on many exciting projects and draw insights from industry-leading experience.

title: Customer Care Analyst
description:
Do you have a proven track record in customer service within a technical environment? Are you experienced in sales and billing management, providing technical support and handling after-sales support? Are you self-driven and goal oriented, with a strong technical background and a passion for technology, innovation and sustainability?

At DEIF, we are currently looking for a full-time Customer Care Analyst based in Campinas, Brazil.

DEIF A/S is a worldwide leader in power efficiency, and we are on a journey to make a real difference in the world. We pursue an ambitious growth strategy and want to be a global trendsetter in power efficient products and solutions. We aim to be the go-to partner for efficient power management, renowned for our intelligent platforms and smart solutions.

About The Job

The Customer Care Analyst will serve as a key point of contact, delivering consistent, high-quality, and world-class customer service/support to our clients.

This role requires excellent communication skills and a collaborative, solution-oriented mindset. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment while maintaining composure and professionalism. A strong understanding of business needs is essential, along with the ability to contribute to a team dedicated to solving customer challenges.

Working Tasks and Responsibilities

  • Supporting all post-sales activities.
  • Successfully preparing, booking, and managing the lifecycle of all quotations in a timely manner, including their relevant follow-ups.
  • Handling incoming calls/inquiries from prospects, customers and leads.
  • Providing customers with technical support and general product and service information.
  • Serving as the primary customer contact and ensuring all customer needs and expectations are met.
  • Ensuring strict adherence to business processes and controls to ensure best-in-class customer service and seamless order management fulfillment.
  • Collaborating with other departments such as technical support, sales managers, product managers, etc.
  • Handling purchasing orders and import process monitoring.
  • Ensuring good document control and setting up new customers in CRM and updating existing records as needed.
  • Identifying, investigating, and resolving customer needs using the database/ERP system and other global webservice systems.
  • You will support ordering processing including monitoring order status and resolving discrepancies/complains if needed.

What You’ll Bring

  • Education in Electronics/Industrial/Automation or Engineering or related field. Business education is also acceptable.
  • Experience in customer service, sales environment and/or technical procedures.
  • Passionate about customer service and customer-centric approach.
  • Ability to communicate in English – both writing and speaking.
  • Self-motivated, with excellent communication skills.
  • Well-organized, with a hand-on/proactive approach and a strong team player.
  • Good understanding of the importance of health and safety in the workplace.

At DEIF, we are Winning Together!

We promise you'll experience a culture based on values such as Ambitions, Perspective, and Respect, where we are Winning Together. We are a global company and work in many different locations – however, we are all united by a wish to make our customers and colleagues succeed. You'll experience a highly professional work environment where continuous learning, empowerment, and collaboration are essential.

We are in a continuous process of developing new intelligent products and solutions that can contribute to accelerating the green transition. Sustainability is central to our business, and we have recently been recognized as the EY Entrepreneur of The Year 2023, where we won the award in the ESG category.

title: Plant Operations Manager
description:
About Teknia – We are a multinational industrial company specialising in manufacturing metal and plastic components for mobility. Founded in 1992, we operate 21 production plants across 11 countries and employ more than 3,500 professionals. By combining a wide range of technologies, we collaborate with the leading manufacturers in the global automotive sector.

We are the sum of our factories and the people who make them possible. A growing company that has evolved thanks to the commitment and talent of our people.

About the Position – We are looking to hire an Industrialization Manager to join our team in our TEPEJI DEL RIO PLANT (MEXICO) .

The selected candidate will lead operations and capital investment projects while ensuring plant readiness for new product launches and production requirements. They will drive operational excellence across the plant, guaranteeing the achievement of safety, quality, delivery, cost, and productivity targets in line with customer expectations and business objectives. The role will also be responsible for promoting continuous improvement initiatives, operational efficiency, and compliance with automotive industry standards.

The responsibilities of the position include:

  • Lead small, medium, and large-scale industrialization and capital investment projects using project management methodologies.
  • Ensure plant readiness for new product launches and production requirements.
  • Coordinate production line modifications and engineering change management activities.
  • Manage contractors, suppliers, and internal resources involved in projects.
  • Control project budgets, capital expenditures, and investment execution.
  • Collaborate closely with internal departments, suppliers, and customers to achieve project and operational objectives.
  • Lead plant operations, ensuring compliance with production schedules and operational targets.
  • Drive the implementation of Lean Manufacturing, Continuous Improvement, and TPM initiatives.
  • Ensure compliance with automotive quality standards, including IATF 16949, APQP, PPAP, and SPC.
  • Lead audits and oversee corrective and preventive action plans.
  • Promote a strong safety culture, cost control, and talent development across the organization.
  • Monitor and improve operational KPIs to enhance plant performance and competitiveness.

Experience and Education

  • Academic Background: Bachelor's Degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related field. A Master's Degree is considered an advantage.
  • Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in a similar leadership role and 8-10 years of experience within the automotive industry.
  • Proven experience managing plant operations, preferably within Die Casting and Machining environments.
  • Strong knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, TPM, Continuous Improvement methodologies, KPI management, and Project Management.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams and managing large-scale industrialization projects.
  • Language Skills: Fluent English.

What We Are Looking For

  • Strong leadership and people management skills.
  • Excellent project management and organizational capabilities.
  • Strategic mindset with a hands-on approach to operational challenges.
  • Ability to work effectively with customers, suppliers, and multidisciplinary teams.
  • Strong problem-solving, decision-making, and communication skills.
  • Passion for continuous improvement and operational excellence.

If you're looking for a dynamic environment and a project with international scope, Teknia is the ideal place for you . We look forward to receiving your application!
